failure: six tests failed because test outputs were outside the production ACL root and one lowered test cap was rejected as a frozen schedule mismatch.
resolution: Test-mode temp storage isolated from production ACL checks; static frozen row ceiling separated from a lower injected test cap.

failure: cost-cap test expected a partial stop after one request, while the runner correctly rejected the entire frozen schedule before transport when its total conservative reserve exceeded the test cap.
resolution: Test now asserts preflight rejection and no additional fake transport calls.

failure: malformed response fixture lacked model identity; fail-closed runtime stopped after one request and the test expected all 120.
resolution: Fixture now includes the expected alias/fingerprint while retaining malformed finish_reason.

failure: scorer imported SCHEDULE but the schedule builder exports OUT.
resolution: Import now aliases OUT as SCHEDULE.

failure: inline Python command used invalid PowerShell/newline quoting and exited with SyntaxError before reading any run files.
resolution: Read-only inspection rerun via a quoted here-string; it confirmed historical responses use model=deepseek-flash and finish_reason=tool_calls.

failure: git diff --check flagged CRLF bytes as trailing whitespace in new appended documentation and a JSON rewrite.
resolution: Normalized only touched text files to LF; subsequent git diff --check passed.

failure: The first combined run after activating the user grant failed because the zero-call researchctl lifecycle fixture copied the active DeepSeek authorization, and because an interrupted-attempt fixture had an unrealistic zero cost reservation.
resolution: The zero-call fixture now uses an isolated empty authorization snapshot and no copied grants; the interrupted request fixture records the exact frozen peak reserve.

failure: The combined checks passed 43 offline tests but git diff --check found CRLF bytes after the user-approved budget snapshot was written on Windows.
resolution: Normalized the modified budget JSON to LF; rerun whitespace validation before commit.

failure: researchctl rejected the authorization because budget.json source text differed from the immutable grant source.
resolution: Copied the exact immutable grant source into the budget snapshot.

failure: The initial runtime authorization check failed before model dispatch because the sibling evaluate_cycle import was not on sys.path.
resolution: Use PYTHONPATH=research/frozen_eval; rerun the identical authorization check and verify the same schedule hash and projected bodies.

failure: researchctl rejected the first closure staging record because the frozen v1 compatibility validator requires evidence_class to match the preregistration.
resolution: Add evidence_class=monitor_evaluation to the staged closure and retry registry validation; no experiment, score, or authorization data changed.
